133975.overview: Alien is a basic side-scrolling shooter where the player controls a fighter jet and must shoot down a variety of different enemies. The game scrolls continuously to the right, while enemies attack the player by either shooting or attempting to crash into the player's craft. The player can fire normal shots, or charge up to fire an extra powerful shot, which is required to defeat certain types of enemies. At the end of each stage, a large boss enemy appears, which must be defeated to continue the game.

Assembloids is a fast-paced action puzzler in arcade style.
The basic concept of such an puzzler was originally developed by Photonstorm in the flash game 'Quartet'.
